short_description: AI on your phone. Free. Works in airplane mode.
full_description:
AGI runs on your device first. No cloud required, no account needed, no data leaving your phone for Local Mode.

Most AI apps funnel your conversations through remote servers. AGI is different: in v1, responses are generated by an open-source language model running on your device. Airplane mode? Still works. No Wi-Fi? Still works.

WORKS OFFLINE
The default model downloads once over Wi-Fi and runs locally after that. No Local Mode inference calls hit AGI Cloud. Your local conversations stay on this device and are encrypted at rest.

FREE AT INFERENCE, FOREVER
Local on-device inference is free and always will be. There is no usage limit, no per-message charge, no subscription required to use the core chat. Cloud mode is separate and invite-gated.

CLOUD WHEN YOU CHOOSE IT
AGI Cloud will add shared chats, more models, connectors, and subscriptions. In v1, Local Mode is active and Cloud access is invite-gated from inside the app.

PRIVACY FIRST
We comply with India's DPDP Act 2023 and the EU AI Act Article 50. Local Mode collects no personal data by default. If you join the AGI Cloud waitlist, your email is used only for access notifications. Export or delete your local data at any time from Settings.

INDIA-FIRST
AGI is designed to work well on the connections and devices common across India: it runs offline, installs once, and handles Hindi queries.

Built by AGI Automation LLC, USA.

release_notes_v1_0_0:
AGI 1.0 — first release.

• On-device AI chat — no account, no Wi-Fi required
• Default model: Qwen3-4B (Apache 2.0, ~2.4 GB)
• Health Connect (optional, read-only, Android 14+)
• On-device voice transcription
• DPDP Act 2023 and EU AI Act Article 50 compliant

Email support@agiworkforce.com — we read everything.
